start_boundary: Result.startTest entry before ordinary progress log;does not alone establish test-body execution

state_rules.RUNNING: start marker observed without terminal callback and still open
state_rules.PASS_FAIL_ERROR_SKIP: one actual original unittest callback outcome;call-return and evidence status separate
state_rules.UNKNOWN: multiple original callback outcomes or completed call without a known callback;all actual callback statuses retained,no precedence invented

persistence_states.RESULT_OBSERVED_IN_MEMORY: original observation captured before diagnostic formatting/logging
persistence_states.RESULT_CHECKPOINT_COMMITTED: checkpoint returned seq/hash acknowledgement after io_write and fsync
persistence_states.RESULT_PERSISTENCE_FAILED: no result write attempt entered tracked write stage;record uncommitted
persistence_states.RESULT_PERSISTENCE_UNKNOWN: write-stage entered or acknowledgement uncertain;no complete persistence claim

RESULT_DURABLE.True: exact referenced observation received trusted checkpoint acknowledgement
RESULT_DURABLE.False: not committed/known failed before write,not a physical0-cost assertion
RESULT_DURABLE.scope: observation record,not complete diagnostics/case finalization/global task

submission_order: protected L0 header and original expected/source bindings
finally cached per-case details and TEST_CASE_EVIDENCE checkpoint
idempotency: same record object/event has one commit attempt;already committed returns same acknowledgement;failed/unknown never retried. Distinct callbacks get distinct id:ordinal and preserve all;multiple callbacks yield aggregateUNKNOWN without original-status priority.
journal_verification: use existing strict r35 checkpoint JSONL+lossless codec parser
validate original hash-chain and fsynced acknowledged prefix under IO trust model
case id/event id/status/source/group must match decoded TEST_ASSERTION payload
match every receipt seq/hash/path to that exact line;do not accept a ref merely because it looks like a digest
CASE_EVIDENCE binds cached original detail values/indices/hashes and result receipts;final details remain raw values
committed prefix remains immutable;partial suffix or invalid ref does not imply durable record
source_bindings: frozen test source hash+runner hash+original expected in case observation,plus PRECHECK/RUN_STARTED chain source/control bindings
normal_return_vs_result: case_call_completed/case_interrupted separate from actual original outcome;logger failure after PASS can retain committed PASS and interrupted audit
availability_boundary: arbitrary disk/RAM/OS failures cannot guarantee durable complete evidence;confirmed prefix and honest UNKNOWN/incomplete/native nonzero retained when possible
pending9_L2: unchanged original full-content duty,never accepted as complete
